name: 3I/ATLAS (C/2025 N1)
about: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS seen by two space telescopes: Canada's NEOSSat (visible light, 15 cm telescope, ~800 km orbit) and NASA's SPHEREx (infrared, 0.75-5 um). NEOSSat followed it from July 2025 to February 2026, through perihelion (29 Oct 2025).
credit: NEOSSat data courtesy of the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), via the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre (CADC, NRC Canada); SSOIS by CADC. SPHEREx data: NASA/JPL-Caltech/IPAC (IRSA). Positions: JPL Horizons. Astrometric and photometric reference: ESA Gaia DR3.
licence: NEOSSat: "NEOSSAT - Astronomy Data" (open.canada.ca), Open Government Licence - Canada. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada.

units.neossat: background-subtracted counts per pixel (ADU); magnitudes on the Gaia G scale
units.spherex: MJy/sr minus the cutout median; fluxes in mJy
